variants.rot: Rotation of loops whose test loads from memory

methodology: Physical Alpha, checks off, learning off. standard-ab with each revision's in-process runner and bundle, CPU 3, 7 rounds of 11 samples, shuffled order, every run checked against the C digest.
placement_check: Bytecode has the same LIR in every bundle. The cross run gives each runner the other revision's bundle: its time follows the bundle, and its unchanged native code moved 0x60 bytes.
